decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut again, is positioned as the firm's flagship, and costs little to keep as a seasonal item, so its value is confirmed and it warrants further commitment rather than abandonment.

The dark barley malt rye bread kept a page of its own in 2024 while three sister breads were dropped, which suggests it passed the firm's screening; it has no visible results yet, but keeping it costs little in an existing bakery line, so the option stays open.

The marzipan stollen still has its own page and benefits from the flagship stollen's reputation and shared seasonal production, so keeping this low-cost option is sensible while its value is confirmed.
